# 02-concept

Machine definition and limits, operating environment, risk assessment, safety functions and required PL, risk reduction concept, human-robot interaction, cybersecurity and ML concepts, insufficiency analysis.

Standard clauses: ISO 12100 §5–§6, ISO 3691-4 §4 and Annex A, ISO 10218-2, ISO/TS 15066, ISO 13849-1 §5 and Annex A, ISO 13855, IEC 62443-4-1 SR, ISO/IEC TR 5469.
